description: Source code for filename utility functions related to URL parsing, filename sanitization, and extension correction within the Chromium project.

methods.name: SanitizeGeneratedFileName
methods.description: Sanitizes a filename by trimming trailing dots/spaces and replacing path separators with underscores.

methods.name: GetFileNameFromURL
methods.description: Extracts filename from URL's last path component, decoding UTF-8 and handling query overwrites.

methods.name: IsShellIntegratedExtension
methods.description: Checks if a file extension is integrated into Windows shell (e.g., .lnk, .local, CLSID).

methods.name: EnsureSafeExtension
methods.description: Ensures filename has a safe and appropriate extension based on MIME type, avoiding shell-integrated extensions.

methods.name: FilePathToString16
methods.description: Converts a FilePath to a UTF-16 string.

methods.name: GetSuggestedFilenameImpl
methods.description: Generates a suggested filename based on URL, content disposition, suggested name, and other parameters.

methods.name: GenerateFileNameImpl
methods.description: Creates a filename from URL and other parameters, returning a FilePath.
